t: This is Bolan's Rock Shrine, a memorial on Queen's Ride in Barnes to the glam-rock musician Marc Bolan of T. Rex. It stands where he died on 16 September 1977, as a passenger in a car that hit a fence and then a sycamore tree. A memorial stone was unveiled here in 1997, and a bust of him was added in 2002. Bolan was a pioneer of glam rock in the early seventies, and he's cited as an influence on punk, new wave, indie and Britpop. He was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2020.
